errors.location: Method, Dynamic Weight Fusion Block description, paragraph following Equation (5)
errors.description: The stated spatial sharing of the fusion weight contradicts the claimed spatially adaptive frame selection. A channel-mixing weight shared across spatial positions applies the same frame/channel coefficients everywhere, so that operation cannot assign different fusion weights to well-exposed and badly exposed locations as claimed.
errors.evidence: The block is said to "spatially and adaptively select useful information across frames", selecting reference information in well-exposed regions and non-reference information in badly exposed regions. The subsequent fusion step instead uses "the weight Δw that is shared in spatial dimension and fully connected in channel dimension".
